review:
Epic SixSixSix is the higher-ceiling Epic version of Hacksaw's devil-themed SixSixSix. Blue or Red 6 symbols on reels one, three or five spin Wicked Wheels that can award multipliers, multiply existing multipliers, add another 6 on blue wheels, or stop on the max win slice. Red wheels carry bigger multipliers.

Three FS symbols offer a choice of a gamble or 10 free spins full of Wicked Wheels, and four offer a gamble or 10 spins where every wheel is red. Five FS start the Epic Bonus, with a red wheel on every spin. Hacksaw publishes 5/5 volatility, a 20,666x max win and RTP versions of 96%, 94% and 92%. It suits experienced high-volatility players.
